have huc' : UniformContinuous (e.symm : β → α) := e.symm.isometry.lipschitz.uniformContinuous

· intro h
  constructor
  intro f hf
  obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := CompleteSpace.complete (hf.map huc')

    rw [Filter.map_map]

    _ ≤ Filter.map (e : α → β) (nhds a) := Filter.map_mono ha

  constructor

  refine ⟨e.symm a, ?_⟩
  have h1 : Filter.map (e.symm : β → α) (Filter.map (e : α → β) f) = f := by
    rw [Filter.map_map]
    have h2 : (e.symm : β → α) ∘ (e : α → β) = id := funext fun x => e.symm_apply_apply x
    rw [h2, Filter.map_id]

    _ ≤ Filter.map (e.symm : β → α) (nhds a) := Filter.map_mono ha

have hb : nndist (I.lower i) (I.upper i) ≠ 0 := fun h => hlt.ne (nndist_eq_zero.1 h)

  Finset.le_sup (f := fun j : ι => nndist I.lower I.upper / nndist (I.lower j) (I.upper j))

  exact_mod_cast key
